description: Part single, part 2-storey rear extension, hip to gable roof extension involving front and rear dormers, roof lights and front porch extension.
decision_conditions: The proposed extensions, by virtue of size, design and roof form represent an overly dominant, incongruous, and visually intrusive form of development that fails to relate to, or appear subservient to the original dwelling unbalancing the pair of semi-detached bungalows and would be disproportionate to the established character, form and pattern of development, detrimental to the visual amenities of the subject property and surrounding area. The proposals are thereby contrary to Policies D3 of the London Plan (2021), Core Strategy (2010) Policy CP30 and Development Management Document (2014) Policies DMD11, DMD13 and DMD37 and National Planning Policy Framework (2026).

The proposed extensions by reason of size, siting, depth and roof form would have an overbearing effect upon the adjoining properties Nos. 28 and 32 Manorway that would result in a sense of enclosure and loss of outlook and privacy detrimental to the amenities of those adjoining neighbouring properties, contrary to London Plan (2021) Policies D3, Core Strategy (2010) Policies CP30, Development Management Document (2014) Polices DMD8, DMD11, DMD13 and DMD37 and National Planning Policy Framework (2026).
